title: Add via URL ?action=add opens the editor and stays open after the list resolves (regression)
verifies: the editor opens on the add route and the guard keeps it open after the late list response resolves

title: Edit via URL ?action=update&name=X opens prefilled with a locked name (regression)
verifies: the update route opens the editor for an existing destination with the name field locked

title: Create destination via the Add button
verifies: the two-step add wizard creates a pipeline destination that appears in the list

title: Edit via row button keeps the name locked and persists a URL update
verifies: row edit locks the name and a URL change is persisted on re-open

title: Cancel from the add editor returns to the list and clears the action
verifies: cancelling the editor restores the list and hides the editor title

title: Delete a single destination via the row button and confirm dialog
verifies: confirming the delete dialog removes the destination row

title: Bulk delete multiple destinations via multi-select
verifies: selecting two rows and confirming bulk delete removes both destinations

title: Form validation blocks submit on required fields and a trailing-slash URL
verifies: empty name/url show field errors and a trailing-slash URL triggers the trailing-slash rule

title: Custom type shows the HTTP method select and enables the endpoint input
verifies: the custom type reveals the method select and enables the endpoint input
